title: Akiyama Mizuki — Obsessed With Cuteness〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<You want to eat at this hour?
It's going to be super bad for your skin and make you put on weight.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Yes, it's easy to get hungry while you're working. Oh, K, can you take a look at the lyrics here?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Speaking of food, K, you're always eating instant noodles, right? What brand and what flavor?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Oh! This photo was taken in your room, K?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <So that's what your room looks like...>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Excuse me, we're talking about instant noodles here.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Yes. Because you can eat them as long as there's hot water. Yuki, thanks for the lyrics. I think they're good.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Great. I'll keep going in this direction, then.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Hey, back to the noodles.
I agree they're convenient, but they're also not too healthy for the body, right?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Oh. Well at least you're taking care of yourself.
Aren't you tired of always having the same thing every day, though?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: (Which means what she eats is so delicious that she doesn't mind having it every day?)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Again? You said the same thing yesterday.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Hehe. So what are you going to eat today?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Instant noodles!
I bought the exact same one K was telling us about.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<What, you too?
I went out to buy that particular brand out of curiosity, too...>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <You mean you sent your li'l bro to buy it for you?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'll go boil some water now.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Me too.
K, let's take a little break.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Probably?
Mine is already three minutes in.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Time to dig in!
Fwoo, fwoo... Wow, it's good.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<I'm digging in, too!
Get in there!>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Huh? Did I just hear a plopping sound?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<What was that?
You forgot to add the condiments?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Nah, I was dropping in some ice cubes.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Yeah, I have a sensitive tongue, you see.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Now, stir well until the ice melts and...done.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <I put in less hot water to make room for the ice, so it'll be fine!>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<Okay, that should do.
Yes, the temperature's perfect♪>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Hey, this is pretty good for an occasional meal! Yummy♪>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: (What a strange way to eat instant noodles...)
